positioning.main_campaign_angle: The soft-drink fizz you love, made from real hibiscus and ginger, zero added sugar.
positioning.target_audience: Urban Gen Z and young professionals (18-30) in Vietnam who want a low-sugar, functional alternative to soft drinks
positioning.key_selling_message: Fizzy Roots gives you the soda experience your cravings want, without the sugar guilt your body doesn't.

creative_routes.hook_idea: "POV: you want a soda but not the sugar crash" - problem-agitate-solve opener in first 2 seconds
creative_routes.visual_direction: Close-up can crack + fizz pour shot, natural daylight, UGC hand-held style
creative_routes.message_angle: Pain-point led: sugar guilt vs. craving

creative_routes.hook_idea: "We brewed real hibiscus + ginger so you don't need sugar" - ingredient-led reveal opener
creative_routes.visual_direction: Studio macro shots of hibiscus flowers and ginger root transitioning into the can, clean gradient background matching brand colors

ab_test_plan.what_to_test: Hook style: sugar-guilt pain point (Route A) vs. real-ingredient credibility (Route B)
ab_test_plan.expected_learning: Whether Gen Z VN responds more to an emotional sugar-guilt hook or a rational ingredient-credibility hook, to prioritize creative direction for the next 3 SKUs.

keep: Add-to-cart rate is strong once a viewer watches past 3 seconds - keep front-loading a strong visual hook
Local sourcing / provenance message resonated in comments - keep 'Made in Vietnam' framing
change: CTR underperformed benchmark on the previous SKU - test a faster, punchier hook in the first 2 seconds instead of a slow brand intro
Shift more budget toward TikTok Shop given 62% of prior sales came from that channel
stop: Stop using generic 'diet soda' framing - comments show customers want to know about the functional ingredients, not just 'less sugar'
test_next: Test ingredient-led hook (hibiscus + ginger) as a new angle not tried in the previous campaign
Test a shorter 15s cut vs. the previous 30s cut to see impact on watch-through rate
